name: Ticket Fairy public API
description: The event listing is public and needs no API key. Reads that return a person's data, and every write, need a credential: see https://www.ticketfairy.com/auth.md. Prices, fees and availability change, so read the live event page or this API for anything a user will pay for rather than quoting a cached copy. Version 1 changes only by addition. A retirement is announced with the Deprecation and Sunset headers at least 6 months ahead: see https://www.ticketfairy.com/api/v1/versioning.md. The organiser operations need a Bearer token. For your own scripts, create a Personal Access Token in your account settings (https://manage.ticketfairy.com/account). For an AI agent that acts for a person, see https://www.ticketfairy.com/auth.md. The token carries the person's role, so it reaches only the brands and events they can reach. Send Accept: application/vnd.api+json on every organiser request: without it, some addresses go to an older API that answers 400 NOT_LOGGED_IN. Responses carry Content-Type: application/json.
